days.mission_in: Listen for one bird you can hear from the path.
days.entry: Mom and Dad walked down the lane to the corner. There was a big neem tree near the corner where the crows were sitting and making a lot of noise. The vegetable vendor was packing up his cart. The air felt a little cooler today, that was nice.

Mom and Dad were out today. They mentioned a bird singing sweetly in the lane, but they could not see which one it was. They thought it might have been near the neem tree. Everything else was normal, and the vendor was standing with his cart.

days.entry: Mom and Dad were out walking today. The flowers were out on the bush outside the corner house, and they both liked them. They didn't stop for long because it looked like it might rain, maybe.
